defs.def: a piece of writing in which the words are chosen for their sound and the images they suggest, not just for their obvious meanings. The words are arranged in separate lines, usually with a repeated rhythm, and often the lines rhyme at the end. 诗；韵文

ex.s: It may be a stand-alone piece such as a poem or short story or a part taken from a larger piece.
ex.t: 可以是独立作品，如一首诗或一篇短篇小说，也可以是较大作品中节选的一部分。

ex.s: A 150-word poem.
ex.t: 一首150字的诗。

ex.s: Riders have printed nearly 20,000 short stories and poems since the program was launched last March.
ex.t: 自去年3月该项目启动以来，乘客已打印了近两万篇短篇故事和诗歌。

ex.s: Much in the same manner, we may over the years recite to ourselves poems learnt by heart long ago, which have become part of our self-recognition.
ex.t: 多年以后，我们可能会像这样背诵自己早已熟记于心的诗歌，它们已成为我们自我认知的一部分。

ex.s: Renewed contact with a novel or a poem can activate the search for a better knowledge of the self.
ex.t: 重新接触一部小说或一首诗，可以激发人们对更深入了解自我的探索。

ex.s: That’s what happened the day my club was reading aloud a poem by Henry Longfellow.
ex.t: 那天我的读书俱乐部大声朗读亨利·朗费罗的一首诗时，就发生了这样的事。

ex.s: I guess I was better than the others, for Miss Chevalier asked a while later, “Addie, I was wondering if you would recite the whole poem to the Saturday evening’s club.” She said a famous professor was going to give a lecture about the poet, and a presentation of that poem would be a fresh way to start.
ex.t: 我猜我比别人强，因为雪瓦利埃小姐过了一会儿问："艾迪，我在想你是否愿意在周六晚上的俱乐部上背诵整首诗。"她说一位著名教授将要做一个关于这位诗人的讲座，而朗诵那首诗会是一个新颖的开场方式。

ex.s: To me, that was the biggest thing ever and I soon learned the whole poem by heart, well prepared for our first rehearsal.
ex.t: 对我来说，那是有史以来最了不起的事，我很快就把整首诗背了下来，为我们的第一次排练做好了充分准备。

ex.s: Halfway through the poem, Miss Chevalier stopped me and asked if I knew what “impetuous” meant.
ex.t: 读到诗的一半，雪瓦利埃小姐打断我，问我知不知道"impetuous"是什么意思。

ex.s: She asked me which one fitted the poem.
ex.t: 她问我哪一个词适合这首诗。

ex.s: Why was Addie asked to recite Longfellow’s poem to the Saturday evening’s club?
ex.t: 艾迪为什么被要求到周六晚上的俱乐部朗诵朗费罗的诗？

ex.s: She memorized the poem sooner than others.
ex.t: 她比其他人更早记住了那首诗。

ex.s: But other channels of creativity stayed open: I went on writing poems and stories.
ex.t: 但其他创造力的渠道依然敞开：我继续写诗和故事。

ex.s: The British romantic poet William Wordsworth grew up in the Lake District,which was a great ________ of inspiration for his poems.
ex.t: 英国浪漫主义诗人威廉·华兹华斯在湖区长大，那里是他诗歌灵感的巨大______源泉。

ex.s: The author agrees with the message of the poem.
ex.t: 作者同意这首诗传达的信息。

ex.s: Write a poem about how courage, determination, and strength have helped you face challenges in your life.
ex.t: 写一首诗讲述勇气、决心和力量如何帮助你面对生活中的挑战。

ex.s: ■Write a poem using 100 words or fewer.
ex.t: ■用100字或更少的字写一首诗。

ex.s: Your poem can be any format, any number of lines.
ex.t: 你的诗可以是任何格式任何行数。

ex.s: Typing your poem out.
ex.t: 打印你的诗。

ex.s: Writing a poem of 120 words.
ex.t: 写一首120字的诗。

ex.s: The third book is Julio Cortazar’s Save Twilight: Selected Poems, because poetry.
ex.t: 第三本书是胡里奥·科塔萨尔的《拯救黄昏：诗选》，因为诗歌。

ex.s: Try writing your own friendship poem.
ex.t: 试着写一首你自己的友谊诗。

ex.s: Background information Homer is traditionally regarded as the author of two epic poems from Ancient Greece, The Iliad and The Odyssey.
ex.t: 背景信息 荷马传统上被认为是古希腊两部史诗《伊利亚特》和《奥德赛》的作者。

ex.s: Scholars still debate whether a single poet named Homer ever existed, as the poems were transmitted orally for many years before they were written down, and may have been worked on by many different poems.
ex.t: 学者们仍在辩论是否真的存在一个名叫荷马的诗人，因为这些诗歌在被记录下来之前口头流传了很多年，而且可能经过许多不同诗人的加工。

ex.s: The Odyssey is the second of the two epic poems attributed to the Ancient Greek poet Homer.
ex.t: 《奥德赛》是归功于古希腊诗人荷马的两部史诗中的第二部。

ex.s: The Iliad is an epic poem, reputedly by the Ancient Greek poet Homer, which recounts the last weeks of the Trojan War.
ex.t: 《伊利亚特》是一部史诗，据说是古希腊诗人荷马所作，讲述了特洛伊战争最后几周的故事。
